ref_text: The market opens slowly in the mornings. Shutters rattle up one by one, a radio plays somewhere behind a wall, and the first customers stand at the counter counting out their change.

lines.text: You get one chance to hear what was in that box, so remember every word.
Slowly, madam. Everything that was in it.
My box! Milk, sugar, ginger, cardamom, the cups, the strainer, the biscuits, my kettle, the spoons!
The kettle, the spoons, and the tea.
Every word she did say was about tea, so that's what stuck, in your memory and in his notebook.
Even he went looking for the tea.
If you said no, name the nine things she did say.
